name: Authoritative access
requirement: Protected requests shall recheck role, ownership, suspension, expiry, session version and token revocation on the server.
status: Implemented control; live multi-account acceptance pending.

name: Credential protection
requirement: Passwords shall use per-account random salts and scrypt; browser cookies shall be HttpOnly, SameSite Lax and Secure in production.
status: Implemented control; production cookie inspection pending.

name: Request origin and transport
requirement: Production shall reject insecure backend transport and unexpected cross-origin writes; browser security headers shall be applied.
status: Implemented control; deployed reverse-proxy acceptance pending.

name: Financial precision
requirement: Amounts shall respect the selected supported currency and its minor units; explicit costs shall not be charged twice.
status: Intended acceptance rule; inspect D-07 before sign-off.

name: Grounded identities
requirement: AI shall not introduce unapproved place identities, prices or media; country and venue evidence shall be validated separately from coordinates.
status: Implemented validation; reference completeness and provider behavior not guaranteed.

name: Honest degraded service
requirement: Failures shall produce a labeled unavailable, retryable or catalog fallback result without fabricating successful delivery, pricing or reservations.
status: Implemented control; external outage rehearsals pending.

name: Atomic persistence
requirement: Multi-record changes shall use transactions and concurrency checks; stale generation, versions and activity previews shall not overwrite newer state.
status: Implemented control; live PostgreSQL contention tests pending.

name: Duplicate prevention
requirement: Generation, save, batch visits, feedback and pending appeals shall apply their documented identity keys and duplicate semantics.
status: Implemented control; isolated service evidence only.

name: Responsive layout
requirement: Public and role workspaces shall remain usable without unintended horizontal overflow at 320, 768, 1024 and 1440 CSS pixels.
status: Proposed release acceptance set; historical emulated evidence is limited to named reports.

name: Keyboard and motion access
requirement: Core actions shall be keyboard reachable, inputs shall have meaningful labels, images shall have useful alt text, and Earth shall respect reduced motion.
status: Partly inspected; complete keyboard, contrast and assistive-technology audit not executed.

name: Timeout and cancellation
requirement: Provider adapters and generation shall use bounded deadlines and cleanup; cancellation shall not be represented as guaranteed provider billing cancellation.
status: Implemented deadlines; 45 s AI adapter, 540 s outer generation and 580 s proxy are ceilings, not performance measurements.

name: Data minimization
requirement: Application outputs and documentation shall not expose credentials, tokens or confidential user records; optional GPS shall require explicit permission and stop on cleanup.
status: Implemented controls inspected; retention policy and privacy notice reconciliation pending.

name: Attribution and provenance
requirement: Photos, map tiles and geographic assets shall retain required attribution and source metadata; unresolved media shall not borrow another place identity.
status: Implemented manifest/credits; Bir Tawil geographic-area photo remains unresolved.

name: Operational recovery
requirement: A release shall have an approved backup, restore, migration and rollback procedure tested against disposable data before production use.
status: Proposed operational acceptance; no automatic backup worker or executed recovery evidence located.

name: Contract consistency
requirement: Generated frontend API contracts shall match the authoritative backend schemas; published OpenAPI shall cover actual routes.
status: Partial; generated checks exist but 10 actual route operations lack exact OpenAPI entries.

name: Traceable changes
requirement: Version changes, managed activity actions and moderation shall preserve attributable history without claiming cryptographic audit immutability.
status: Implemented records; role-restricted read access, not a tamper-proof ledger.

name: Shared rate limits
requirement: Rate limits shall persist across instances where configured and provider requests shall honor bounded request pacing and retry advice.
status: Implemented PostgreSQL buckets and in-memory provider pacing; distributed provider quotas not proven.

name: Reproducible verification
requirement: A release decision shall separate static inspection, historical evidence, newly executed checks and unexecuted acceptance procedures.
status: Satisfied for this documentation evidence boundary; release approval pending.

name: Measured performance
requirement: Performance acceptance shall record hardware, data volume, network, load, p50/p95/p99 and error rate against an approved target.
status: Proposed acceptance method; legacy sub-2-second/500-user/99.9-percent targets are unapproved and unmeasured.

name: Date and time consistency
requirement: Trip date eligibility and activity-local clocks shall use an explicit, consistent time-zone policy across client and server.
status: Intended rule; browser-local versus server-UTC past-date edge remains D-03.
